nomineeA.longerDescription: Tokyo Tower is a communications and observation tower located in Shiba-koen district. Standing at 333 meters tall, it has become one of Tokyo's most recognizable landmarks and offers spectacular views of the city. The tower is particularly beautiful when illuminated at night.

nomineeB.longerDescription: Margot Robbie has become one of the most sought-after actresses in Hollywood. From her breakout role in The Wolf of Wall Street to her critically acclaimed performance as Tonya Harding in I, Tonya, and her iconic portrayal of Harley Quinn, she brings energy, talent, and authenticity to every role. She's also a successful producer through her company LuckyChap Entertainment.
